Resource Profile: Composición epicrisis SIHCE

Official URL: http://sihce.gob.ar/StructureDefinition/CompositionEpicrisisSIHCE Version: 2.2.2
Standards status: Trial-use Maturity Level: 3 Computable Name: CompositionEpicrisisSIHCE

Documento estructurado de epicrisis (LOINC 18842-5). Nivel 2: secciones tipadas con text. Nivel 3: solo Motivo de internación (46241-6) con entry Condition + ICD-10. Resto de codificaciones en propuestas de votación.

Usages:

  • Examples for this Profile: Composition/CompositionEpicrisisNivel2 and Composition/CompositionEpicrisisNivel3

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics

cmp-1 error Composition.section, Composition.section:alergias, Composition.section:diagnosticoAlta, Composition.section:medicamentosAlta, Composition.section:evolucionHospitalaria, Composition.section:planTratamiento, Composition.section:diagnosticoAdmision, Composition.section:medicamentosIngreso, Composition.section:motivoInternacion, Composition.section:instruccionesAlta, Composition.section:resumenEstudios, Composition.section:hallazgosFisicos, Composition.section:historialProcedimientos, Composition.section:listaProblemas A section must contain at least one of text, entries, or sub-sections text.exists() or entry.exists() or section.exists()
cmp-2 error Composition.section, Composition.section:alergias, Composition.section:diagnosticoAlta, Composition.section:medicamentosAlta, Composition.section:evolucionHospitalaria, Composition.section:planTratamiento, Composition.section:diagnosticoAdmision, Composition.section:medicamentosIngreso, Composition.section:motivoInternacion, Composition.section:instruccionesAlta, Composition.section:resumenEstudios, Composition.section:hallazgosFisicos, Composition.section:historialProcedimientos, Composition.section:listaProblemas A section can only have an emptyReason if it is empty emptyReason.empty() or entry.empty()
dom-2 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources contained.contained.empty()
dom-3 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6 best practice Composition A resource should have narrative for robust management text.`div`.exists()
ele-1 error **ALL** elements All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1 error **ALL** extensions Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()
